CONTENT TYPES AND TAXONOMIES Post types and taxonomies are the site's: the theme, WordPress or another plugin registers them. These tools do not create, change or delete them. List them with list-post-types and list-taxonomies. When a task needs a type or taxonomy the site lacks, say so: the site administrator adds it. Use list-terms and the term tools for a taxonomy's terms; set-post-terms on content. Do not manufacture term IDs or write serialized storage manually.
A content type defines structured records and URLs; it does not generate a frontend layout. The active theme and installed blocks provide rendering; these tools write no PHP. Use fields-contract for data definitions and content-contract for record content. list-post-type-fields discovers Fabrement, ACF and registered meta declarations. Discovery is not blanket write support for arbitrary ACF post meta. ACF block data is handled separately inside Gutenberg content.
